content.short: Stablecoin credit market where users borrow ebUSD against yield-bearing assets at rates they set.
content.description: Ebisu lets borrowers mint ebUSD against collateral such as WBTC, weETH, sUSDe, XPL and XAUt0, choosing their own interest rate, and loop it for up to 11x exposure. Holders of ebUSD earn protocol revenue and liquidation gains by staking in the Stability Pool. It runs on Ethereum and Plasma, is audited by Zellic, and counts Frax founder Sam Kazemian among its backers.
content.meta: Borrow ebUSD against WBTC, weETH, sUSDe or XAUt0 at a rate you choose, or earn from the Stability Pool, on Ebisu.
